relations: Continuous water ripples subtly deform and blur the reflected bare branches and leafy foliage.
The tiny bright speck maintains its position while its shape wobbles from the moving water.
The overall reflection layout remains broadly fixed as the water surface undulates without settling.
caption: The video captures a near-still water surface seen from above, mirroring the surrounding trees and sky. Across the top, the fine bare branches of a reddish-brown tree are reflected, while a pale overcast sky fills the upper region and dark cloud-like shapes pool in the center. Along the right edge, leafy green foliage appears in reflection, and a single tiny bright speck rests just below the middle. The surface ripples continuously, so the dark central reflection and the reflected branches and foliage subtly deform, blur, and shift in outline. This undulation is already underway and continues without settling. The small bright speck holds essentially the same position throughout, its shape wobbling between a dot and a tiny crescent as the water moves beneath it. The layout of the reflections stays broadly fixed, consistent with a stationary camera, while the visible motion is the gentle ripple of the water.
